property-disallowed-list.message: Use logical CSS properties (margin-inline-start/end, padding-inline-start/end, inset-inline-start/end) — see CLAUDE.md non-negotiable #1. One stylesheet must serve both directions.

color-no-hex.message: Colour literals live only in src/styles/tokens.css — use a semantic --c-* token (CLAUDE.md: semantic tokens only; ADR-011).

color-named.message: Colour keywords are literals too — use a semantic --c-* token (ADR-011).

function-disallowed-list.message: Colour functions are literals — define the colour once in src/styles/tokens.css and use the semantic token (ADR-011).

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Palette tokens are not for components — use the semantic --c-* layer so dark mode follows (ADR-011).
